source_refs.section: Step 1 of the steps list (links and replies)
source_refs.applicability: Any phone; the text warning is not specific to a platform
source_refs.verified_excerpt: Scammers want you to react quickly, but it's best to stop and check it out.
source_refs.model_visible_text: On any phone: Don't click on any links in, or respond to, unexpected texts. Scammers want you to react quickly, but it's best to stop and check it out. A scam text may show an amount owed and link to a page asking for bank or credit card information. If you click the link, they could get your personal info.
